title: On Guessing the weight of the pig
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：guess　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 guess 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the foreman ① guessed the weight of the pig twice over, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the foreman ② guesses the weight of the pig year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ guess the weight of the pig at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ guessed the weight of the pig before — a line in the sheet for May 1977 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Guessing the weight of the pig twice over, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ guess the answer at the first try year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Guess the answer at the first try at once and never mention it again.

By 1990 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the sheet, and a new worker from the next site ⑧ guesses the answer at the first try twice over every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ramp, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ guessed the weight of the pig again when nobody else would.

⑩ To guess the weight of the pig, my mother said in 1995, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody guesses the weight of the pig year after year again and somebody must guess the weight of the pig twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 猜（一般过去式 guessed the weight of the pig：1983 年工头头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 猜（一般现在 guesses the weight of the pig：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 猜（不定式 to guess the weight of the pig：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 猜（过去完成时 had guessed the weight of the pig：1977 年五月的施工单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 猜（动名词 guessing the weight of the pig 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 猜到（guess the answer at the first try：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去猜到第一次就猜到了答案）
G. v. 猜到（guess the answer at the first try：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 猜（后段两处：新来的工人照例 guesses the answer at the first try，而母亲又一次 guessed the weight of the pig）

answers.why: guess 意为“猜”，1983 年工头来回两遍猜猜那口猪有多重，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 guessed。
guess 意为“猜”，自那以后工头年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 guesses。
guess 意为“猜”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯猜猜那口猪有多重”，此处为不定式 to guess the weight of the pig。
guess 意为“猜”，施工单里 五月 那行字说明早在 1990 年之前就有人猜过，故用过去完成时 had guessed。
guess 意为“猜”，工头说“猜猜那口猪有多重这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 guessing the weight of the pig 作主语。
guess 意为“猜到”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去猜到第一次就猜到了答案”，should ever 之后用原形 guess the answer at the first try。
guess 意为“猜到”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻猜到第一次就猜到了答案（guess the answer at the first try at once），以后再也不要提起。
guess 意为“猜”，新来的工人每个班次都照例猜到第一次就猜到了答案，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 guesses。
guess 意为“猜”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍猜猜那口猪有多重，用一般过去式 guessed 叙述。
guess 意为“猜”，结尾那句是母亲 1995 年的话：要猜猜那口猪有多重，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 guess 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the foreman guessed the weight of the pig twice over, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the foreman guesses the weight of the pig year after year whenever the site asks.
Guessing the weight of the pig twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever guess the answer at the first try year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next site guesses the answer at the first try twice over every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother guessed the weight of the pig again, and the site remembered that half.
